descript.abstract: A mapped waste site may contain more than one polygon, line, and/or point feature. This shapefile contains a representation of all of the point, line and polygon features that make up mapped waste sites at the Department of Energy's Hanford Site. The spatial data in this shapefile was compiled from many different sources including translation from annotated field maps, estimates based on published reports, digitizing from aerial photography and scanned drawings, and global positioning surveys. The mapped location is based on the best available information. As more information is acquired through the declassification of documents and photos, newly identiifed drawings, and field work associated with remediation planning, the mapped location is modified to account for the newly identified information. None of the WIDS mapping is absolute. Waste sites, especially associated pipelines, may have been modified in the field without ever updating the design drawing. In some cases, excavation has shown that the construction and location of a waste site was completely different from what is shown on approved "as-built" drawings.
descript.purpose: The purpose of this shape file is to indicate the location of known or suspected waste sites. The mapped location provide a starting basis for remediation planning and field activities. The mapped sites are also used during excavation and drilling activities to identifying potential hazards at the work site.

theme.themekt: Spatial Data Standard for Facilities, Infrastructure, and Environment v2..2

idinfo.accconst: This information can be accessed by employees of the Department of Energy (DOE) and Hanford contractors without limitation. Data can only be passed to non-Hanford entities on an "as needed" basis. Before any such data transfer, a classification officer should be contacted.
idinfo.useconst: The newest revision of the data should be used on maps. Before creating a map with a copied dataset, the user should check for a newer version in the Hanford Spatial Data Clearinghouse.

secinfo.sechandl: Some information mapped in this dataset has been determined to be sensitive with regard to the location of facilities that might be terrorist targets. Information can only be passed to non-Hanford entities on an "as needed" basis. Before any such data transfer, a classification officer should be contacted.

citeinfo.title: Source Shape Files
citeinfo.othercit: The ehsit.shp file was created by merging object data from the ehsitirp, ehsitpip and ehsitpir shape files. The line data in ehsitpip were buffered to a distance of .5 meters. The point data in ehsitpir were buffered to a distance of .5 meters. The two buffered sets were merged with the polygon data in ehsitirp. The boundaries between the resulting data were dissolved on the Site_Num field. This allows a search for a WIDS site as a single object instead of a group of points, lines and polygons.

procstep.procdesc: The ehsit.shp file was created by merging object data from the ehsitirp, ehsitpip and ehsitpir shape files. The line data in ehsitpip were buffered to a distance of .5 meters. The point data in ehsitpir were buffered to a distance of .5 meters. The two buffered sets were merged with the polygon data in ehsitirp. The boundaries between the resulting data were dissolved on the Site_Num field. This allows a search for a WIDS site as a single object instead of a group of points, lines and polygons.
The shapefile attributes are updated with WIDS data from the WIDS database. This is done by SQL Data Transformation Services.

New fields ERS_CL_RCL and ERS_OP_DES are added for symbolization purposes. ERS_CL_RCL is the concatenation of the ERS_CLASS and ERS_RECLAS fields. ERS_OP_DES is the description of the operable units in 200 areas. This field is taken from the field ERS_OPRUNT. This is done by Data Transformation Services.
The WIDS shapefile is imported into SDE geodatabase.

altsys.altenc: Explicit elevation coordinate included with horizontal coordinates

attr.attrdef: Matches to the WIDS "Site" table, "SiteCode" field. This field is a unique code assigned to a site that is created during site identification and is automatically generated by the database system. For new sites, the Site Code is automatically assigned by the database when the potential site is entered into the database. It is given a prefix indicating the designated area in which the site is located (such as 100-D, 200-E, 300, 600, etc.), followed by the next sequential number from the previously entered site for that area. For sites entered in the database prior to reengineering of the WIDS (1995), the site code was generally assigned in accordance with the facility-naming convention at the time it was entered. Some site codes were modified during database reengineering, such as converting very long names to initials, to be more consistent with current practices. Older names were added to the Site Names field.

CalculateField ehsit_new1 ERS_OP_DES strValue VB "if InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"IS" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Infrastructure"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"LW" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Chemical Waste"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"PW" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Process Waste"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"TW" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Tank Waste"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"ST" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Septic Tanks"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"MW" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"UR" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Unplanned Releases"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"CW" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Cooling Water"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"CS" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Chemical Sewer"
Elseif InStr( [ERS_OPRUNT],"SC" ) > 0 then
strValue = "Steam Condensate"
Else
strValue = ""
end if"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB-TEST hgic_test (SDE).sde\hgic_test.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB-TEST hgic_test (SDE).sde\hgic_test.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"
