If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"

CalculateField "Database Connections\GISDB HGIC (SDE).sde\hgic.SDE.ehsit" ERS_OP_DES stringvalue VB "Dim stringvalue
If (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "IS") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Infrastructure"
ElseIf (InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "LW") > 0) Then 
 stringvalue = "Chemical Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "PW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Process Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "TW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Tank Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "ST") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Septic Tanks"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "MW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Miscellaneous Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "SW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Solid Waste"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "UR") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Unplanned Releases"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CW") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Cooling Water"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OPRUNT], "CS") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Chemical Sewer"
ElseIf InStr([ERS_OP_DES], "SC") > 0 Then
 stringvalue = "Steam Condensate"
Else stringvalue = ""
End If"
